arithmetic: For every K-support coordinate of every frozen square-terminal F state, quotient the support group modulo R by the subgroup generated by all other support primes. The cyclic quotient target class gives the exact minimum absolute exponent and coordinatewise overflow floor over the full target fiber. The original exponent box distance Psi_0 is computed independently as a multi-source Cayley-graph distance to -1.
scope_note: The coordinate floor is selection-invariant over the complete target fiber, but it is only a coordinatewise necessity. It does not prove a carrier charge, a compatible carrier flow, an overflow-to-carrier injection, or a universal Type I/II escape theorem. The intrinsic profile uses exactly the K-exponent bounds nu. The extended box adds current source-block heights that are already saturated inside nu, so it is retained only as a counterfactual one-reuse rectangular relaxation, not a compatible capacity.
